title: Kava's KAVA falls 47% in two hours to a record low near $0.036
dek: KAVA sat flat near $0.068 for two days, then broke down at 5:05 a.m. ET on November 14 and hit an all-time low of about $0.0356 before 7 a.m. ET. Prices on Korea's Upbit and Bithumb stayed far above the rest of the market.

title: Pearl rose 18% in a day while bitcoin slipped. It is still 37% below its October record
dek: The token of Pearl, a blockchain that pays GPU miners for AI math, climbed from about $1.31 to $1.55 in 24 hours to Saturday, November 14, and is on CoinGecko's trending list. Bitcoin fell 1.6% over the same day.

title: AKE rose 82% more after our Friday report as $583 million traded, twice its value
dek: Akedo's AKE token rose another 82% from Friday morning to early Saturday and is up almost fourfold from its 24-hour low, CoinGecko data show. It is still 92% below its September record.

title: One wallet took in $32.8 million of ARB in a week as ARB fell 14.5%. DeepSea shows $0 sent
dek: A large Arbitrum wallet kept receiving ARB from four addresses and bought more, DeepSea's data show, through one of the token's weakest weeks. Who owns it is unknown, and we could not check it on a block explorer.

title: Two tokens named ni hao cat: one fell 90% overnight, then jumped 9x in a day
dek: CoinGecko lists two "ni hao cat" tokens with the same MIHAO ticker, one on Ethereum and one on Solana. The Ethereum one went from a record to a 90% loss and back up 9x in 24 hours, all in a single Uniswap pool.

title: HYPE rose 4% as bitcoin fell 5%. Longs pay on 84% of its $2.6 billion in futures bets
dek: Hyperliquid's token was the best performer among CoinGecko's 50 largest coins on the day bitcoin fell below $70,000. Futures traders kept betting on it to rise, and on Hyperliquid itself HYPE bets now outweigh ether's.

title: USDC shrank $361 million in a day as bitcoin fell below $70,000. USD1 lost 2%
dek: The 20 biggest stablecoins lost $559 million in value in 24 hours, and Circle's USDC was most of it, CoinGecko data show. Tether's USDT barely moved this time, while a few smaller dollar tokens grew.

title: Nvidia bets traded $1.95 billion on Hyperliquid in a day, more than ether, as bitcoin fell
dek: In the 24 hours to 6:38 a.m. ET Friday, the day after Nvidia announced its CEO's exit, its main perpetual market on Hyperliquid outtraded ether's and trailed only bitcoin's. Stock and commodity markets now hold 35% of the exchange's open bets, CoinGecko data show.

title: Bitcoin fell below $70,000. Shorts now pay longs on 60% of its $43.7 billion in futures bets
dek: Funding turned negative on seven of the ten biggest bitcoin perpetual markets as the price fell 5% in a day, CoinGecko data show. Solana bets leaned even harder toward a fall. XRP and zcash bets did not.

title: A $101 million shark lost $1.21 million in a week, then sold 11 altcoins in two minutes
dek: Hold91cc, an Ethereum wallet we have followed since November 8, now trades about $1.24 billion a month. Its 30-day result has turned to a $1.14 million loss.

title: Two Hyperliquid traders made $111.7 million in the week bitcoin fell below $70,000
dek: DeepSea's smart money board puts SMc060 at +$57.45 million and SM6e36 at +$54.30 million over 7 days. Together they hold 60% of the top 10's gains.

title: Sharks' weekly loss quadrupled to $10.5 million. Yesterday's top wallet is down $1.35 million
dek: In about 30 hours, DeepSea's 7-day table went from minus $2.56 million to minus $10.50 million for big traders. The best wallet this time made just $121,574.

title: A shark sold 29.17 million WLD for $8.49 million in one trade as bitcoin fell below $70,000
dek: An Optimism wallet that DeepSea tags as a shark dumped about 0.78% of all circulating WLD overnight. Its closed trades are down $2.83 million in 30 days.

title: Akedo's AKE jumped 151% in a day. It is still 95% below its September record
dek: An AI game-making token on BNB Chain traded more than its own market value in 24 hours while bitcoin fell. Less than a quarter of its supply is circulating.

title: Rumor vs record: 7 viral claims about bitcoin's fall below $70,000, checked
dek: Posts about Friday's crypto drop spread fast: a first since August, a 45% fall from the record, $1.2 billion liquidated, Nvidia to blame. We checked seven claims against price data and official records.

title: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August. Ether dropped under $2,000
dek: Bitcoin fell to $67,922 and ether to $1,905 overnight, the lowest since mid-August, and the crypto market lost 6.8% of its value in a day. Rate fears and fund outflows built up all week.

title: Bitway (BTW) drops 29% in a day, now 74% below its October record
dek: BTW fell from $1.06 to about $0.71 in 24 hours on thin volume of about $7.3 million, with Gate handling more than a third of the trading.

title: BlackRock's IBIT shed 22.7 million shares in four sessions as bitcoin fell to $68,393
dek: iShares data shows IBIT's share count down 1.6% since November 6, roughly $919 million at Thursday's NAV. Bitcoin lost 7% in 24 hours.

title: Ether fell 14% in a week, yet 912,000 ETH is waiting in line to be staked
dek: Ethereum's entry queue holds 3.5 times more ether than its exit queue, Validator Queue data show. SharpLink's labeled wallet staked another 128 ETH on November 12 as the price slid.

title: One company sold its last 211 bitcoin at $76,000. Strategy bought 1,036 at $79,012
dek: Hyperscale Data says it has sold all its bitcoin, about 1,113 BTC since July. Strategy kept buying, but spent more than twice as much buying back its own preferred stock. Bitcoin now trades at $68,521.

title: Rumor vs record: Nvidia says Huang resigned but gives no reason. Was he ousted?
dek: Nvidia announced its CEO's resignation on November 12, 2026, and crypto feeds filled with claims about why and what it did to prices. We checked six of them against Nvidia's own filing.

title: KPMG counted Tether Gold's bars: 520,089 ounces for 520,089 tokens
dek: Tether says KPMG gave Tether Gold (XAU₮) a clean audit for 2025, its second Big Four audit after USDT. The gold matched the tokens almost to the ounce.

title: USDT shrank $2.69 billion in 8 days, but Tether's Ethereum treasury still holds $4.65 billion
dek: Etherscan shows 4.65 billion USDT parked in the wallet it labels Tether: Treasury, which kept sending tokens out through November 12. CoinGecko counts $5.47 billion of USDT as not circulating.

title: Fed's Waller set a 0.3% test for a half-point hike. October's core CPI hit it
dek: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a 25 basis point hike in December could hurt the Fed's credibility if core inflation stayed near 0.3%. Hours later, October's core reading came in at 0.3%.

title: US moves to seize $1.2 billion of the Binance hack haul and shuts down North Korea's deepfake call trap
dek: The Justice Department says it won court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance on October 29. It also took down servers behind "FaceStealer," a fake video call scheme it ties to more than $400 million in thefts.

title: 64 of 90 bitcoin treasury companies are below cost at $72,857, Strategy by $2.21 billion
dek: At $72,857 a coin, the public companies that report what they paid for bitcoin hold $3.01 billion less than they spent, CoinGecko's treasury tracker shows. Ether holders look worse: 14 of 15 are under water.

title: ARB fell 8% after one wallet's $3.17 million buy. Shorts now pay on 79% of its futures bets
dek: Sharks bought $3.65 million of Arbitrum's ARB in a day and sold $9,135, DeepSea's data show. The price kept sliding, and on most futures markets traders betting on a fall now pay those betting on a rise.

title: Bitcoin Core discloses 3 bugs fixed in 2025. The worst could stop a node building blocks
dek: Bitcoin Core published three security advisories on November 10, one rated high. All were fixed in releases from October 2025, and the advisories describe no theft of coins.

title: U.S. bitcoin ETFs lost $1.49 billion in five straight days as bitcoin fell 9%
dek: Spot bitcoin funds have now seen money leave on eight of the last nine trading days, $2.57 billion in all, CoinMarketCap's tally shows. Ether funds lost $477 million in the same five days.

title: MEET48's IDOL rose 65% and halved in under 16 hours. Futures traded 16 times spot
dek: The small BNB Chain token jumped from $0.024 to $0.040 on Wednesday evening and was back below $0.020 by dawn. Open futures bets on it are worth more than the token's whole market value.

title: PEPE fell 11% in a day. Shorts now pay longs on half of its $465 million in futures bets
dek: The frog memecoin was the worst performer among the 50 biggest coins on CoinGecko. Its open futures bets equal about a quarter of its market value, and on the biggest market, Binance's, shorts now pay longs.

title: PayPal's PYUSD shrank $136 million in a day and $377 million since its October 27 peak
dek: The PayPal dollar token lost 4.9% of its market value in 24 hours, CoinGecko data show, while Ripple's RLUSD and the Global Dollar held steady. Its price never left $1.

title: Rumor vs record: MSCI's cut makes funds sell Strategy shares, not Strategy's bitcoin
dek: After MSCI dropped Strategy from its USA index, posts warned of $2.8 billion to $8.8 billion in "forced selling" and asked what it means for bitcoin. We checked four claims against MSCI's own documents and Strategy's latest SEC filing.

title: A shark lost $4.03 million on 7 trades in a week, then bought $468,070 of a SpaceX token
dek: A single BNB Chain wallet now accounts for more than half of the sharks' net loss on DeepSea's 7-day table. In the past day, the same address spent nearly half a million dollars on a SpaceX stock token on Arbitrum.

title: A shark lost $1.21 million on four chains in a week, then sold $1.36 million on Optimism
dek: The wallet DeepSea calls Hold1f17 shows realized losses on all four chains it traded this week. In the last 24 hours it also made the largest sell-only move of any shark.

title: Two Avalanche wallets made 3,121 trades in a day, five times Monday's pace, and ended near even
dek: DeepSea's shark table shows $4.86 million of bridged ether and bitcoin bought on Avalanche and $4.72 million sold. Almost all of it came from the same two wallets, swapping back and forth.

title: Bitcoin fell 8.5% in a week, XRP 20%, zcash 25%. Sharks did not dump bitcoin or ether
dek: CoinGecko's 7-day numbers show the big coins sliding together. DeepSea's 24-hour shark table shows big wallets near flat on bridged bitcoin and ether, buying ARB and WLD and selling OP.

title: OKX and NYSE owner ICE open 24/7 tokenized stock trading on November 23, with 70+ assets
dek: OKX says its joint venture with Intercontinental Exchange, OKXICE, starts trading tokenized US securities around the clock on November 23 under a temporary SEC exemption. OKB rose about 5% from Tuesday noon to Wednesday morning ET.

title: Sharks sold $3.64 million of OP in a day, $1.3 million more than they bought
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour table puts Optimism's own token at the top of shark selling across every chain it tracks. OP is down 12.5% in a week on CoinGecko and 98% below its record.

title: 75 of 102 shark wallets lost money this week. One BNB Chain wallet made $967,000
dek: DeepSea's 7-day profit table shows big traders down $2.56 million on closed trades, winning one trade in three. A single wallet made 80% of all the gains.

title: Deutsche Bank custody site says bitcoin, ether and 3 stablecoins are available in Germany
dek: Germany's largest bank says its digital asset custody is available to Corporate Bank clients in Germany. Retail customers are not part of it.

title: Rumor vs record: will an "ANT" Anthropic stock token go live on Solana on IPO day?
dek: A viral post says a tokenized Anthropic share called ANT will launch on Solana the day Anthropic starts trading in public. CoinGecko does list an Anthropic xStock with a Solana address, but under a different ticker, with zero supply and no price. We found no Anthropic or issuer statement that sets a date.

title: Stablecoins lost $13.4 billion in 30 days. USDT alone shrank $8.3 billion
dek: CoinGecko data shows the three biggest dollar tokens all got smaller since mid-October. Tether's USDT fell every week, and November 11 was its worst day of the month.

title: One wallet bought $3.17 million of ARB in one trade, a day after its $3.29 million CHIP buy
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour table shows Arbitrum sharks bought $3.65 million of ARB and sold $771. Most of it came from one wallet that Etherscan shows holding 135 million ARB.

title: Only 89 of 210 KOL wallets made money in 30 days. Top earner kurtz won 11 of 11
dek: DeepSea's realized PnL table shows most tracked influencer wallets lost money over 30 days, yet the group is up $374,000 as a few big winners carried the total.

title: MSCI cuts Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its USA index after November 30
dek: MSCI's November review list names "Strategy A" among 24 deletions from the MSCI USA Index. Funds that copy the index will have to sell the stock by the close of November 30.

title: Initia's INIT falls 71% from its day high to $0.113, below where its rally began
dek: INIT touched $0.392 in the past 24 hours, then slid to about $0.113 by 10:05 p.m. ET on November 11. That is lower than its price before the November 9 surge, with traders swapping three times its market value in a day.

title: SEC cases fall to 348 from 456 as crypto examples include a $95.6 million mining fraud
dek: The SEC's fiscal 2026 enforcement results, released November 10, show 348 actions and $1.095 billion in ordered money. The crypto cases it highlights are retail frauds, from a $14 million fake platform scheme to an FTX audit case.

title: 21 REX-Osprey altcoin ETFs get a new start date, November 20, after 13 months of waiting
dek: An October 22 SEC filing pushes back the effective date for 21 planned REX-Osprey funds, from AAVE to XLM. Most of their tokens fell 15% to 38% in the past 30 days.

title: Midnight's NIGHT airdrop thaw ends December 4. The last 25% installments are landing now
dek: NIGHT claimed in the Glacier Drop and Scavenger Mine unlocks in four 25% steps, and Midnight says the whole thaw ends December 4, 2026. NIGHT trades 64% below its record.

title: Rumor vs record: is a hacker really selling 335.9 million Binance user records?
dek: A "pay or leak" ad offering 335.9 million Binance records, private keys included, has been reshared online. We checked each claim against Binance's own pages and a threat intelligence firm's review. Nothing confirms it, and its headline number is close to a counter anyone can read on Binance's homepage.

title: US prices rose 0.4% in October, with no yearly inflation rate. Bitcoin fell 1.4% on the day
dek: October's consumer price index, out November 10, slowed from September's 0.6% jump. The Labor Department could not publish the usual 12-month rate because it collected no data in October 2025. Bitcoin dipped about 0.6% in 20 minutes around the release and ended the day near $73,650.

title: Grayscale's Hyperliquid ETF staked 90% of its $197 million, earning 10,341 HYPE in a quarter
dek: The quarterly report of Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF (HYPG), filed with the SEC on November 10, shows 2.22 million HYPE in the fund on September 30 and a $48.3 million quarterly gain. HYPE has since dropped about 19%.

title: Stablecoins shrank $1.25 billion in a day. USDT and USDC on Ethereum fell $1.06 billion
dek: The eight biggest dollar stablecoins lost $1.25 billion in 24 hours and $4.86 billion in a week, DefiLlama data show. Ethereum and Hyperliquid shed the most, while USDC grew on Solana, Arbitrum and Base and USDT grew on Plasma.

title: Lighter's LIT rose 10%, and Hyperliquid holds more LIT bets than Lighter itself
dek: LIT climbed to $3.47 while Lighter's fees held near $260,000 a day on DefiLlama. Rival Hyperliquid carries $61.4 million of open LIT bets, against $39.1 million on Lighter's own market.

title: Zcash fell 12% to $1,015. Hyperliquid lost 57% of its open Zcash bets in a day
dek: ZEC dropped from about $1,160 to $1,015 in 24 hours. On Hyperliquid, open interest in the ZEC perpetual fell from $486.8 million to $211.3 million, CoinGecko data show, the steepest cut of any big venue.

title: A Monad shark put $3.6 million into earnAUSD, a fifth of the yield token's market value
dek: The busiest shark on Monad bought $16 million of tokens in a day, mostly dollar tokens. Its biggest one-way bet was a yield version of AUSD that CoinGecko values at $17.7 million.

title: Optimism sharks lost $293,000 in a week, 20 of 24 in the red, yet bought $1.41 million of WLD
dek: DeepSea's PnL table shows a bad week for big wallets on OP Mainnet. In the last day they bought more WLD than they sold and sold more OP than they bought.

title: The week's top shark made $1.52 million on 3,619 trades, then sold $369,000 of BTCB
dek: The BNB Chain wallet that bought $5.4 million of ether three days ago leads every wallet in DeepSea's 7-day profit table. At 12:34 a.m. ET it sold 5 BTCB in one trade.

title: One wallet bought 5% of all circulating CHIP in a single $3.29 million trade
dek: DeepSea logged an $18.4 million Arbitrum shark wallet buying USD.AI's CHIP token as it traded 50% below its price of a month ago. Arbiscan shows the wallet now holds 100 million CHIP.

title: Kinetiq's KNTQ fell 25% in a day and now trades at half its October 30 record
dek: The token of Hyperliquid staking project Kinetiq slid from about $0.40 to $0.30 in two sharp drops on Tuesday, November 10, while HYPE and bitcoin moved less than 3%. More than half of the trading ran through Hyperliquid's own spot market, CoinGecko data shows.

title: Canada proposes barring banks from issuing stablecoins directly. Subsidiaries only
dek: Budget 2026 proposes to bar federally regulated banks, trust companies and insurers from issuing stablecoins themselves. They would have to use a separate non-financial subsidiary that the Bank of Canada supervises.

title: BitMine bought 9,587 more ether, but its staking income estimate fell $49 million in a week
dek: BitMine Immersion now reports 6,070,092 ETH. It staked no new coins this week, its yield estimate slipped, and ether's drop since its count has cut about $870 million off the pile's value.

title: Sharks bought $36.4 million of RLUSD in a day. Over the week, whales sold $12 million net
dek: Two wallets made 37 trades in Ripple's stablecoin in 24 hours. One of them, with $97 million on DeepSea, swaps it in blocks of up to $4.5 million.

title: Sharks sold $19 million of gold tokens in a day, a day after buying $8.1 million of XAUt
dek: A handful of big wallets sold $10.5 million of PAXG and $8.5 million of Tether Gold and bought back $2.8 million. Both tokens slipped about 0.9%.

title: 23 influencer wallets bought $555,000 of two new memecoins in a day. No priced sales
dek: The same 23 BNB Chain KOL wallets piled into 狗狗币 and spyless within about two hours. CoinGecko does not list either token.

title: Smart money trader SMffa1 made $13.8 million in a week, 40% of its $34.3 million wallet
dek: DeepSea ranks SMffa1 No. 3 on Hyperliquid this week. At 6:45 a.m. ET its live trades were in stock-price markets such as LITE, SKHY and SOXL, not crypto.

title: Super Inu (SI) jumps 164% in a day, a week after a 97% crash
dek: The Ethereum meme coin traded near $0.016 early Tuesday, about 23 times its November 5 low, yet still 45% below its October 31 record. Almost all trading runs through one Uniswap pool.

title: Janction (JCT) gives back most of its rally: down 65% from Sunday's record
dek: JCT hit an all-time high near $0.0185 on Sunday afternoon. By early Tuesday it traded near $0.0065, down 26% in a day, though still more than twice its price before the surge.

title: Rumor vs record: a viral post credited to Musk said Binance holds 80% of crypto. It does not
dek: A viral post credited to Elon Musk said Binance holds about 80% of the crypto market and urged users to leave. We checked each line against CoinGecko's exchange data and DeepSea's wallet tracker. The 80% figure does not hold up.

title: Zcash fell 9% in two days. Open bets on its six biggest futures markets fell 40%
dek: ZEC slid from $1,279 to about $1,160 since November 8. Over the same stretch, open interest on Hyperliquid, OrangeX, CoinW, Gate, OKX and Bybit dropped from $2.51 billion to $1.50 billion, CoinGecko data show.

title: Initia's INIT jumped about 70% in a day, and traders swapped twice its market value
dek: INIT climbed from about $0.12 to $0.22 in 24 hours, with $98 million to $102 million of trading against a market value under $50 million. Binance carried 43% of it, and a Turkish lira pair led every market.

title: Coinbase's cbBTC gained 2,921 bitcoin in 30 days. Lombard's LBTC lost 39% of its supply
dek: Bitcoin is leaving most wrapped tokens on other chains, CoinGecko supply data shows. Coinbase's version was the exception, until it gave back 891 BTC in a day.

title: Hyperliquid's oil market fell 7% and a chip-stock market rose 21%. Crypto bets shrank $420M
dek: Hyperliquid's crypto markets held $9.18 billion of open bets, down from $9.60 billion a day earlier. Its stock and commodity markets now hold a third of the total.

title: World Liberty's USD1 shrank 22% in 30 days, and USDC lost another $205 million on Monday
dek: USD1 fell from $4.26 billion to $3.32 billion in a month, CoinGecko data shows. USDC kept leaking too, while USDT held flat for a second day.

title: A $93 million shark made 28,847 trades in 30 days, lost $162,000 and doubled its gold
dek: Two days ago Hold91cc was up $26,100 on 12,787 trades. Now it has more than twice the trades, a loss, $18.77 million in Tether Gold and a $173,000 AAVE sale.

title: Smart money SM2b00 made $22 million on $13.29 billion of trades. Now it holds 15 shorts
dek: SM2b00 is No. 4 on DeepSea's 7-day board at +$10.26 million. Its biggest bets are against ETH, SOL and HYPE, and CoinGecko prices show most of them in profit.

title: Influencer panceramic sold $351,000 of silver bets in 20 orders and went all cash
dek: DeepSea shows 20 silver sell orders on Hyperliquid, then a wallet of $353,200 in USDC and no open bets. Ninety percent of the influencer's 30-day profit came this week.

title: Hong Kong moves to ban "crypto exchange" in the names of unlicensed firms
dek: The Securities and Futures Commission has concluded its consultation on misleading business names. Any firm calling itself a crypto exchange, virtual asset market or token trading platform would need SFC approval first, six months after the law passes.

title: Allora's first cliff unlocks 160 million ALLO on November 11, about 38% of circulating supply
dek: One year after launch, Allora's schedule frees a third of the tokens held by early backers and core contributors. At CoinGecko's price on November 9, that is about $23.6 million of new supply against a $62 million market cap.

title: The SEC's crypto capital and records rule for brokers reached the White House on November 3
dek: A proposed SEC rule on how broker-dealers hold capital and keep records for crypto assets reached the White House regulatory office on November 3, 2026. The text is still private. Staff guidance shows where the agency has been heading.

title: Last week's worst crypto influencer is now No. 2 and holds a $13.4 million Zcash short
dek: The KOL wallet mk4 was down $2.84 million for the week on November 5. DeepSea now shows +$2.24 million over seven days, but still minus $876,800 over 30.

title: The No. 1 smart money trader is short $474 million of crypto and up $45.7 million on paper
dek: SMc060 retook first place on DeepSea's 7-day board with +$36.67 million. Its 19 open bets against BTC, ETH, ZEC and others are all in profit on paper.

title: Sharks sold $584,000 of ARB in a day, nearly 4 to 1, as the token edged up 1.1%
dek: Four days after shark wallets bought $850,000 of Arbitrum's token, the flow reversed. One wallet also sold tokenized Circle shares in the last hour.

title: Unichain sharks sold $2.12 million of USD₮0, three days after sharks bought $3.74 million
dek: The flow on Unichain's dollar token flipped. A wallet that was not among Friday's buyers did almost all the selling.

title: One Monad shark made 267 of 268 trades in a day. Its 30-day loss grew to $1.35 million
dek: One wallet made almost every shark trade DeepSea tracked on Monad, cycling $7.1 million through two dollar tokens. Its losses keep growing.

title: Two Avalanche shark wallets made 580 small trades in bridged ETH and BTC as AVAX rose 8%
dek: DeepSea's Avalanche shark feed looked crowded on Monday night. It was mostly two wallets swapping bridged ether and bitcoin back and forth in small pieces.

title: Pieverse (PIEVERSE) doubles in a week to a record $2.13 as Upbit leads trading
dek: PIEVERSE rose 42% in 24 hours and 103% in seven days to a new all-time high on Monday. Upbit and Bithumb, two won-based exchanges, handled more than half of the $58.7 million traded.

title: Ether's 5% drop cut about $956 million from the 8.1 million ETH that public companies hold
dek: CoinGecko lists 35 public companies with ether on their books, 32 with a balance. BitMine holds 74% of it, and 14 of the 15 firms with a listed cost are below it.

title: 429 sharks traded LINK in a day, triple any other Ethereum token, buying $14.1 million
dek: Chainlink's token was the most crowded shark trade on Ethereum as ether fell 5%. Uniswap's UNI drew under a third as many wallets, and they were net sellers.

title: Nigeria sets a ₦15 billion floor for dollar stablecoin issuers and bans algorithmic coins
dek: The Central Bank of Nigeria's new rules say foreign-currency stablecoins can reach Nigerians only through a locally licensed issuer. A foreign license does not count, and peer-to-peer desks need the bank's approval.

title: Trader SMb7ae made $11.5 million in a week, and 18 of its 20 open bets are shorts
dek: SMb7ae is No. 5 on DeepSea's 7-day Smart Money board. Its open positions on Hyperliquid bet against bitcoin, HYPE, Starknet and 15 other tokens.

title: 80 sharks bought $8.1 million of Tether's gold token as ether fell 5%, while PAXG was sold
dek: While ether dropped 5%, large wallets on DeepSea's live feed piled into XAUt. The rival gold token, PAXG, went the other way.

title: Senator Blumenthal gives Binance, Tether and World Liberty until January 4 to hand over records
dek: Senator Richard Blumenthal says the three crypto firms have produced no records he asked for, some requests going back 18 months. His November 5 letters set a first check-in for November 9 and warn of "alternative measures" after January 4.

title: One shark put $49.7 million into Aave USDT as ether fell 5%, and holds $129 million in gold
dek: The same shark wallet we covered on November 5 is back, buying Aave's USDT receipt in five steps. It also holds $129 million of tokenized gold, second only to its restaked ether.

title: Rumor vs record: Strategy's bitcoin is underwater, but no filing shows it must sell
dek: Bitcoin slipped below Strategy's average purchase price overnight, and posts about a $54 billion bet gone bad spread fast. We checked each line against the company's own SEC filing and CoinGecko prices.

title: Solana launchpad token STONK fell 32% in a day and lost $45 million in under two days
dek: StonkFun's STONK token dropped from about $0.10 to $0.044 between Saturday and Sunday evening, now 88% below its September record. Most of the trading ran through Solana DEX pools, CoinGecko's market list shows, and one Meteora pool handled nearly half of all trading.

title: Rumor vs record: did whales really load up on XRP as it slid to $1.10?
dek: XRP fell 5.4% in a day and hit its lowest price since August. Posts say whales are buying the dip. We checked six viral claims. The price claims mostly hold up; the whale claims cannot be confirmed yet.

title: BlackRock's ether ETF lost 19% of its shares since September. Its bitcoin ETF held steady
dek: ETHA, BlackRock's spot ether fund, held about 131.8 million shares on November 6, down from 162.4 million on September 30. That is roughly 693,000 ETH handed back, by our calculation, while the firm's bitcoin fund kept its share count flat.

title: One ether now buys 0.0286 bitcoin, the least since mid-July
dek: Ether lost 2.7% against bitcoin in a day after Sunday's sell-off. CoinGecko's daily data shows no lower close since July 14.

title: Hyperliquid's crypto bets shrank $640 million since Friday, and ether shorts now pay
dek: CoinGecko's per-market data puts Hyperliquid's open bets at $14.0 billion after Sunday's ether drop. Its $1.93 billion ether market now has negative funding, while bitcoin's does not.

title: Big stablecoins shrank another $1.5 billion since Friday. Sky's USDS lost $921 million
dek: Eleven of the largest dollar tokens lost $1.54 billion in market value in three days, CoinGecko data shows. Ethena's USDe went the other way, up $412 million.

title: Shorts now pay longs on 77% of ether's open futures bets. On Friday it was 21.5%
dek: After Sunday's 4.6% drop, funding turned negative on Binance's biggest ether market. Bitcoin barely moved: 1.4% of its bets lean short.

title: A shark bought $2.46 million of staked ether on Monad. DeepSea sees $116 of liquidity
dek: The largest single shark buy of the last day came in three trades on ether's down day. The token's pools on Monad that DeepSea tracks hold only $116, so the buy did not run through them.

title: A smart money trader fell from No. 1 to No. 6. Two days later it is No. 2 with $23 million
dek: SMc060's 7-day profit on DeepSea went from $59.67 million to $9.49 million and back up to $23.24 million. The top 10 now show $129.55 million, all on Hyperliquid.

title: Sharks sold $12.85 million of tokens and bought $7.98 million as ether fell 4.7%
dek: DeepSea's live feed shows big wallets were net sellers on ether's down day. A dollar token on Optimism took most of the selling, and one Monad wallet bought $2.46 million of staked ether.

title: Nvidia's CEO told staff he was unfaithful. Tokenized Nvidia stock fell 7% at the open
dek: Nvidia posted a memo from Jensen Huang on Sunday, November 8, and its board opened an independent investigation. On-chain Nvidia tokens fell 4.7% that evening, and after Monday's open the NVDAx token was still about 4.6% below Friday's close while a tokenized Nasdaq 100 fund rose.

title: Ether drops 4.6% in 20 minutes to $2,122 on Sunday afternoon, twice bitcoin's fall
dek: ETH slid from about $2,224 to $2,122 between 4:40 and 5:00 p.m. ET on November 8, 2026, per CoinGecko. Bitcoin fell 2.2% in the same window. Ether is now down about 5% on the day and 14.5% over 30 days.

title: BlackRock's IBIT shrank $105 million on Friday, yet its share count is flat since September
dek: IBIT, BlackRock's spot bitcoin fund, cut 2.44 million shares on November 6, about 1,380 BTC. Yet it has slightly more shares than on September 30, so nearly all of its $6.4 billion drop in assets since then came from bitcoin's price.

title: Janction (JCT) jumps 285% in a day to a record high as volume tops its market cap
dek: JCT climbed from about $0.0025 to a new all-time high near $0.0107 on Sunday morning. About $175 million changed hands in a day, more than the token's $120 million market cap, and three venues handled 86% of it.

title: Hyperliquid holds $626 million of open Zcash bets, more than Binance's $556.9 million
dek: On a quiet Sunday, Zcash was the second most traded market on Hyperliquid, ahead of ether. CoinGecko's data shows the on-chain exchange now carries the largest pile of open ZEC futures of any venue.

title: Rumor vs record: 128 Japanese banks went dark on November 6. Notices blame broken equipment
dek: A viral reel says 128 banks in Japan were taken down all at once. The outage was real. The official notices we could read point to a failed piece of communications equipment, and none of them mention an attack.

title: A shark bought $612,100 of OP in one trade. Nine hours later its wallet held no OP
dek: An Optimism wallet DeepSea calls Hold9675 bought 6.03 million OP on Saturday night, about 3% of the token's daily trading. Its page now shows no OP among its holdings.

title: A $216 million bitcoin whale shows a $291,600 weekly loss, but its moves look like loans
dek: DeepSea counts an 82% win rate and a 7-day loss for an Ethereum wallet holding only cbBTC. Its trade list reads like a borrower moving collateral in and out of a lending market.

title: A shark lost $1.64 million on 5,488 trades in 30 days, then bought $155,000 of DEBIT
dek: DeepSea's page for a shark wallet ending in 1f17 shows losses on BNB Chain, Ethereum and Optimism. On Sunday morning it kept trading: gold tokens out, small caps in.

title: One KOL lost $44,400 on Sunday, wiping out 82% of what 31 winning KOLs made
dek: DeepSea's one-day board lists 58 crypto influencers with a result on November 8. Most made money, but Loopierr's single loss pulled the whole group about $20,900 into the red.

title: Russia lets ordinary investors buy only BTC, ETH and USDT, capped at about $3,665 a year
dek: The Bank of Russia's directive 7441-U, published November 6, 2026, names just three assets that non-qualified investors may buy through a broker, with a yearly limit of 300,000 rubles. It enters into force 10 days after publication.

title: Two BNB Chain influencers made 18 of the same memecoin trades within hours. Both are up this week
dek: DeepSea's KOL wallets for kurtz and tech bought and sold the same tokens, in the same direction and within about an hour, over two days. DeepSea counts every closed trade of theirs this week as a win.

title: A $100 million Ethereum shark traded $450 million in 30 days. Its profit: $26,100
dek: Three quarters of the wallet sits in three dollar tokens. In four minutes from 12:30 a.m. ET it bought $340,000 of Ripple's RLUSD, sold $131,000 of LINK and made 18 buys of under $10 each.

title: A shark sold $13.4 million of bitcoin, ether and JCT in minutes. The buyer made 81,836 trades in a month
dek: A BNB Chain wallet that DeepSea shows down $1.75 million in 30 days sold three tokens just after midnight ET and now holds $28.7 million in a dollar token. DeepSea logs the buyer of its ether and JCT as one of the most active wallets it tracks.

title: Is the memecoin easy-money era over? The 12 biggest memecoins sit 44% to 98% below their highs
dek: Traders are arguing about whether memecoins still pay. We skipped the opinions and pulled the numbers: prices against all-time highs, Pump.fun's revenue and the size of the meme market today.

title: 6 crypto projects are giving up their own chains for Solana, Ethereum, Base, Sui and Arc
dek: A table of nine "chain migrations" is going viral. We checked each row against the projects' own posts: six are confirmed, three are not. Here is where each one is going and what its token did since.

title: Rumor vs record: did hackers pay $15 to drain $2.5 billion from Binance in 20 minutes?
dek: Headlines about the Binance hack keep spreading. We checked the most shared claims against Binance's own report, DeepSea's hack tracker and CoinGecko prices. The single-transaction part holds up. The "$15" and "20 minutes" framing misses the story.

title: Harmony's ONE jumped 85% in a day and a half. Trading hit 3.4 times its market value
dek: ONE went from about $0.00106 to $0.00196 on CoinGecko as daily trading rose from about $2 million to $97 million. We could not confirm an official reason for it.

title: One Mantle shark swapped ether tokens 208 times in a day. Its 30-day result: minus $2,400
dek: The wallet traded about $314,000 between WETH and Mantle's staked ether token in 24 hours. After 2,219 closed trades in 30 days, it is slightly in the red.

title: An Ethereum shark was down $159,600 for the month. Two days later it's up $18,100
dek: DeepSea's PnL table shows one wallet's 30-day result swing by $130,000 in less than a day of closed trades, while ether went nowhere for the week. It now has the best 7-day result of any Ethereum shark with a 7-day figure.

title: An Avalanche shark swapped $1.45 million of Aave USDC deposits for Benqi's in two trades
dek: DeepSea logged the switch as both the second-largest net shark buy and the second-largest net shark sell of the day across all chains. The wallet's closed trades in the last 30 days: five, all winners.

title: CYBER jumped 53% in about a day, then gave back 20%. Sharks on Optimism bought $668,000
dek: CoinGecko shows the small-cap CYBER token trading four times its market value in 24 hours, with South Korea's Upbit the busiest market. DeepSea's shark wallets were net buyers on Optimism over a day in which the price fell.

title: DeepSea's top 10 smart money traders: $256 million in weekly profit, then $110 million
dek: The 7-day profit shown for the crash-week winners on DeepSea's boards fell by more than half in 24 hours. The top two influencers' figures halved, and sharks are still down $3.15 million on closed trades.

title: Sharks "sold" $16.31 million of uniBTC on Berachain. CoinGecko saw $591 of trading
dek: DeepSea's live feed logged two wallets moving about 212 uniBTC out on Berachain in 24 hours. One of them is a DEX pool, and CoinGecko counted less than $600 of uniBTC trading worldwide in the same day.

title: Rumor vs record: was Chainalysis hit by AI, and did attackers see case files?
dek: Claims about the Chainalysis breach kept spreading as the company posted its November 6 update. We checked eight of them against Chainalysis's own incident page: two are wrong or out of date, and two have no evidence behind them yet.

title: Ruble token A7A5 still trades on Uniswap 15 months after sanctions, for about $1,500 a day
dek: In August 2025, Treasury sanctioned A7A5's issuer along with Garantex and its successor, Grinex. FinCEN's November 6, 2026, MEXC order put new numbers on all three. Public data shows the token still trades in tiny amounts, but it cannot show the transfers between agents.

title: MEXC's tracked wallets shed $166 million before FinCEN's order. Then MX fell 6%
dek: DeepSea's MEXC wallets fell from $1.08 billion to about $918 million between November 5 and early November 6, before FinCEN moved against the exchange. They have barely moved since, and the data does not show why.

title: FinCEN and the Fed drop the 2020 plan to cut the travel rule threshold to $250
dek: The 2020 proposal would have lowered the cross-border threshold from $3,000 to $250 and written crypto into the definition of "money." FinCEN pulled it on November 6, 2026.

title: Rumor vs record: what viral posts got right and wrong about the U.S. move against MEXC
dek: Posts about FinCEN's MEXC order spread fast on November 6 and 7, 2026. We checked each claim against FinCEN's own order. Most numbers hold up; two points do not.

title: FinCEN cuts MEXC off from U.S. banks over $16.7 billion in likely illicit flows
dek: The U.S. Treasury's FinCEN ordered U.S. financial institutions on November 6, 2026, to stop sending funds to or receiving funds from MEXC Global. The ban starts 30 days after the order runs in the Federal Register.

title: What 9 on-chain analytics tools are built for, from block explorers to compliance suites
dek: Arkham, Nansen, Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Dune, Glassnode, DefiLlama, block explorers and DeepSea all read public blockchain data, but each is built for a different job. Here is what each one does, what is free and who uses it, from each tool's own site.

title: Chainalysis now says login tokens for every user were exposed. All must reset passwords
dek: The crypto tracing firm first said only names and emails were reached. Its latest update says live tokens for every user and password hashes were exposed, and its Reactor and Data Solutions products are still offline.

title: A Nasdaq-listed HYPE holder wants to be a US futures broker. HYPE is down 15% in a week
dek: Nasdaq-listed Hyperliquid Strategies says a subsidiary has applied to become a futures commission merchant, a step toward offering Hyperliquid perps to US customers. It also booked a $620.6 million quarterly profit, nearly all of it paper gains on HYPE.

title: Shorts are paying longs on 21.5% of ether's open futures bets, against 1.4% for bitcoin
dek: CoinGecko's data on 287 bitcoin and ether perp markets shows short sellers paying to hold their bets on 21.5% of ether's open interest, against 1.4% for bitcoin, a day after the sell-off.

title: Hyperliquid holds $14.9 billion in open bets, second only to Binance on CoinGecko
dek: CoinGecko ranks Hyperliquid second of all derivatives exchanges by open interest, about $14.9 billion. Its traders also churn their positions far less than on centralized rivals.

title: Stock and oil bets outtraded crypto on Hyperliquid: $9.96 billion vs. $9.67 billion
dek: CoinGecko's market data for Hyperliquid shows its 165 builder-run markets, almost all on stocks, indexes and commodities, did more volume than its 179 crypto perps as bitcoin fell 5%.

title: The shark that took $10 million out of Aave on Arbitrum put $8.32 million back
dek: A day after one wallet drove an $8.35 million net outflow from Aave's USDC pool, it bought back almost all of it. The 7-day net is now just minus $27,800.

title: One shark sold $2.59 million of LYK. The token's Arbitrum pool holds $396
dek: DeepSea logged big shark selling in two layer 2 tokens, LayerK's LYK and Linea's LINEA. LYK's public markets were far too small to absorb what was counted.

title: Two sharks bought $3.74 million of USD₮0 on Unichain in a day and sold just $75,000
dek: A day after sharks were net sellers of the dollar token on Unichain, two wallets flipped to heavy buying. One of them also bought $4 million on Optimism.

title: Sharks bought $3.08 million of tokenized SpaceX on Arbitrum. Its DEX pool traded $56,000
dek: Two shark wallets kept buying rSPCX and rCRCL, tokens CoinGecko lists as tokenized SpaceX and Circle stock, even as both fell. Almost none of it went through the public pool.

title: Lido lost $1.8 billion in value in a day. Did anyone actually leave?
dek: DefiLlama shows DeFi's biggest protocols shrank 4% to 8% in 24 hours. Compared with CoinGecko prices, most of that looks like falling prices, not withdrawals.

title: Bitcoin fell 5% in four hours. Fees peaked at just 12 sats after a 67-minute wait
dek: mempool.space data shows the November 5 sell-off barely stressed the Bitcoin network. The biggest fee jumps came when blocks were slow, not when panic peaked.

title: Curve's trading volume nearly quadrupled to $831 million as crypto sold off
dek: DefiLlama shows the stablecoin swap venue went from $215 million to $831 million in a day, while total DEX volume rose less than 3% and several big DEXs slowed. Its fees jumped about eightfold.

title: Stablecoin supply shrank $5 billion in six days. USDT fell the most
dek: DefiLlama shows the total supply of dollar stablecoins fell every day from October 30 to November 5, the day bitcoin dropped below $76,000. Tether's USDT supply fell $2.76 billion in a week.

title: Exchange wallets lost $11.45 billion in 18 hours. Mostly price, not withdrawals
dek: DeepSea's exchange list shrank 4.7% as bitcoin fell about 6%. Binance's holdings dropped $6.84 billion, and MEXC fell 15.8%, the steepest among large exchanges.

title: 71 of 100 shark wallets lost money on closed trades in crash week, $5.85 million in all
dek: DeepSea's realized profit table shows large traders came out behind as bitcoin fell. Three wallets made up 63% of the loss, and one Optimism wallet won 3 of 61 trades.

title: Influencer slingoor turned a $686,000 week into $9.38 million as bitcoin fell
dek: DeepSea's 7-day KOL board changed fast in the November 5 sell-off. The top two influencers now hold 91% of the profit shown in the top 100.

title: Bitcoin fell 6%. DeepSea's top 10 smart money traders went from $98M to $256M
dek: In about 18 hours, the 7-day profit of DeepSea's ten best wallets more than doubled. All ten trade perps on Hyperliquid, and the leader alone added $47.9 million.

title: Greece puts a 10% crypto gains tax to a final vote. Staking income would pay 15%
dek: Greece's finance minister brought a bill with dedicated crypto tax rules to a final vote in parliament on November 4. Gains up to 500 euros a year would be tax free.

title: GL1 Org launches with HSBC and JPMorgan on its member list. What will it build?
dek: Global financial institutions have formed the Global Layer One Organisation to push shared rules for tokenized markets. Its site lists HSBC, JPMorgan, MUFG, Forge and Standard Chartered as members. The project began at Singapore's central bank in 2024.

title: Base now aims for five blocks a second. What does the Denim upgrade break for apps?
dek: Base's Denim upgrade was set to switch mainnet from one block every 2 seconds to one every 200 milliseconds on November 5. Anything that counts blocks to measure time now runs 10 times faster.

title: Canary's staked INJ ETF heads to Nasdaq as INJC. Fees will take up to 30% of rewards
dek: Canary's Staked INJ ETF filed its final prospectus on November 4. The fund plans to stake most of its Injective tokens and keep 70% of the rewards. INJ rose 2.5% in a day the rest of the market fell.

title: Bitcoin lost $4,400 in four hours. Why did ETH and XRP fall even harder?
dek: Bitcoin slid from about $80,300 to under $76,000 on November 5, most of it between 9 a.m. and 11 a.m. ET. Ether, Solana and XRP dropped 7% to 9%, and the whole crypto market shed about 8% in a day.

title: Trump Media moved 4,259 BTC to Crypto.com from its collateral wallets. A move is not a sale
dek: Two transfers worth about $344 million left wallets that Arkham labels as collateral for Trump Media's $1 billion convertible notes, weeks before holders can ask for their money back.

title: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin lost about $49 million on 17 chains. It says customers lose nothing
dek: Mercado Bitcoin says it contained a security incident on November 2, 2026, and that no customer will lose assets. Chainalysis puts the theft at about $49 million and says close to $9 million has been frozen.

title: Hackers drained French bank Arkéa's own account. It calls a $133 million estimate about right
dek: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed a cyberattack that sent fraudulent transfers out of the bank's own account, possibly into crypto. It denies the attackers came in through Fortuneo and says customer savings are safe.

title: One shark sold $80.5 million of Aave-deposited USDT in an hour. Its 7-day loss: $1.87 million
dek: The Ethereum wallet ending 4312 moved more than $280 million in a day, mostly in and out of Aave. DeepSea's PnL table shows it with the biggest 7-day realized loss it tracks.

title: Seized UK government wallets rank seventh on DeepSea's exchange list, at $3.95 billion
dek: DeepSea's exchange rankings mix trading venues with seized and long-silent wallets, including $574.14 million in failed QuadrigaCX's. Bitfinex ranks second at $31.27 billion, and one Coincheck wallet holds $3.42 billion.

title: Two sharks ran $51.7 million through Aave's USDC pool on Arbitrum. Net $8.35 million out
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour feed shows $30 million of Aave's USDC receipt token sold and $21.65 million bought. One wallet did most of the round trip.

title: Smart money is 15 to 1 long on ether, but only 2 to 1 on Zcash
dek: DeepSea's Long / Short panel shows all seven of its biggest coins leaning long. Ether and NEAR are the most one-sided, while bitcoin carries the largest short bets.

title: A net 16,251 bitcoin flowed onto exchanges in a week. Binance took in the most
dek: DeepSea's dashboard shows a net 1,387 BTC flowed into exchanges in 24 hours, with Binance up 2,479 BTC while Kraken and Bitfinex lost coins.

title: DeepSea's top 10 smart money traders made $98.4 million in a week, all on Hyperliquid perps
dek: The first 41 names on DeepSea's 7-day leaderboard are Hyperliquid perpetual futures traders. The leader made $16.44 million on $208 million of assets.

title: Sharks bought $10.25 million of WLD on Optimism in a day while its price fell 4%
dek: Thirteen big wallets made 240 WLD trades in 24 hours and net bought about $4.31 million. WLD itself fell 4% on CoinGecko.

title: Sharks sold $9.52 million of USD₮0 on Berachain in a day, $3.39 million in the last hour
dek: One busy wallet made 260 shark trades on Berachain, where DeepSea logged 263 in Tether's cross-chain dollar token. A day earlier the 24-hour selling was about a quarter of the size.

title: This week's worst crypto influencer lost $2.84 million and still bets $27.6 million on a fall
dek: DeepSea shows the KOL wallet mk4 on Hyperliquid holding 11 short positions, led by $7.82 million against ether and $7.69 million against bitcoin, while both coins rose overnight.

title: The TRUMP memecoin hit a record low of $1.22. It is now 98% below its January 2025 peak
dek: The Solana token fell 12.6% in two hours on November 4 as trading volume more than quadrupled, CoinGecko's data shows. Its 24-hour volume is now larger than its whole market value.

title: Ether jumped 4.6% in two hours and bitcoin is back above $80,000. Big traders are 86% long
dek: Most of ether's 5.5% daily gain came between 9 and 11 a.m. ET on November 4, CoinGecko's data shows. DeepSea counts $3.35 billion in long bets against $543.87 million in shorts.

title: 177 crypto influencers made money in 30 days. Four others lost $19.8 million
dek: DeepSea's 30-day KOL leaderboard looks like a winning month: 177 of 202 accounts are up. Then you reach the bottom, where Machi Big Brother alone shows minus $12.42 million.

title: The top crypto influencer of the week made $8.84 million and now sits on $25.5 million in USDC
dek: DeepSea's KOL leaderboard puts "2 freres 2 fauves" first by a wide margin, three times the runner-up. Its latest Hyperliquid orders were in silver and copper markets, not crypto.

title: One Monad wallet bought $2.38 million of ether. Its closed trades lost $1.15 million in 30 days
dek: Every shark trade DeepSea logged on Monad in the last 24 hours came from one wallet. It bought wrapped ether and sold fixed-yield dollar tokens.

title: Shark wallets sold $7.85 million of the USD₮0 dollar token on Optimism, a day after buying it
dek: A day ago shark wallets were buying USD₮0 on Optimism. DeepSea's feed now shows them net sellers of almost $3 million, while OP selling kept going.

title: Binance's 7-day flow on DeepSea: a $1.55 billion net outflow after last week's $5.04B inflow
dek: Last week's DeepSea report showed money pouring into Binance. Its live seven-day count now shows $4.54 billion leaving and $3.00 billion arriving.

title: MEXC took in a net $107.6 million in seven days, more than any other exchange
dek: Among the exchanges DeepSea tracks, MEXC topped the seven-day inflow table while OKX, Gate, Bybit and Bitget all saw net outflows.

title: Robinhood's $14.9 billion ranks third on DeepSea. One cold wallet holds $11.27 billion of it
dek: DeepSea's exchanges list puts Robinhood's labeled wallets behind only Binance and Bitfinex. A single Bitcoin cold wallet holds about three-quarters of the total.

title: Sharks bought $850,000 of Arbitrum's ARB in a day. Whales added $4.59 million in a week
dek: DeepSea's data shows big wallets buying ARB on Arbitrum while $11.6 million more ARB left exchanges than arrived over seven days. Two stock tokens also drew shark money.

title: DeepSea tagged 2,790 new smart money wallets in a week, and not a single new bot
dek: DeepSea's weekly report counts 2,615 wallets seen for the first time from October 26 to November 1, plus 652 new DeFi borrowers and 93 new influencer (KOL) wallets. Here is what the labels mean.

title: OKX logged three times Binance's transfer count last week and lost a net $241.6 million
dek: DeepSea's exchange data shows 451,046 transfers at OKX from October 26 to November 1, with almost twice as many withdrawals as deposits. Bybit went the other way, with a net $478.2 million coming in.

title: Asia's local exchanges handled just 1.3% of flows as Binance took in a net $5.04 billion
dek: South Korea led the local markets with $12.5 million net in. Upbit, HashKey, Bitkub and other home-market exchanges together handled about $538 million of deposits and withdrawals from October 26 to November 1, DeepSea's data shows.

title: Shark wallets sold $3.55 million of Optimism's OP in a day and bought just $486,000
dek: DeepSea's live feed shows big wallets selling Optimism's token while still parking dollars on the chain. On Berachain, a heavy seller of USD₮0 turned buyer in the last hour.

title: MachiBigBrother opened $145,405 of ETH longs in 25 seconds, six hours after the last burst
dek: DeepSea's live feed caught the crypto influencer opening six ether long positions on Hyperliquid at 6:33 a.m. ET, after nine more just past midnight.

title: 32,175 crypto addresses are on DeepSea's risk list. Ransomware is the biggest category
dek: DeepSea's database of scam, fraud and sanctioned addresses grew by 1,178 last week. Most new entries were hack-tainted, and Bitcoin holds more flagged addresses than Ethereum.

title: Whales sent out $317 million more than they took in last week. Where did it go?
dek: DeepSea's wallet-to-wallet map shows $1.10 billion leaving whale wallets and $783 million coming back, while unlabeled wallets pushed a net $306 million into exchanges.

title: Two Hyperliquid wallets are up $20.7 million on open bets. The crowd is down $2.19 million
dek: DeepSea's weekly data names the biggest paper winners on Hyperliquid, a 40x bitcoin short opened on October 31, and an ether short now 3.3% from forced closing.

title: Crypto influencers made $590,000 in 30 days. Sharks in DeepSea's live feed lost $10.7 million
dek: DeepSea's 30-day realized profit table puts its live-feed KOL wallets in the green and shark wallets deep in the red. On Hyperliquid, one KOL opened a $538,000 silver short in nine minutes.

title: Whales put $63 million into stablecoins and sold a net $27.6 million of other tokens
dek: DeepSea's sector data shows big wallets moving into dollars last week, while smart money kept buying. Ethereum took most of the $66 million net inflow.

title: Only 29 of 59 tracked BSC wallets made money last week. Smart money won, influencers lost
dek: DeepSea's weekly data shows BSC smart money wallets finished $7,800 up while eight tracked KOLs lost $55,400. One influencer wallet had no green day in seven.

title: The CFTC cleared perpetual futures on US stocks. Cboe and Citadel filed legal action that day
dek: On November 3, CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said perpetual futures on single US stocks can trade on CFTC-registered exchanges for the first time. The same day, Cboe, Citadel Securities and Healthy Markets Association took legal action to stop it.

title: Sharks bought $3.05 million of WLD on Optimism in a day. One Monad wallet traded $15.7 million
dek: DeepSea's live feed shows big wallets loading up on USD₮0 and WLD on Optimism, one wallet churning $15.7 million on Monad and a single $10 million Aave USDC exit on Arbitrum.

title: One Tron wallet moved $751 million of USDT through Binance in about two hours
dek: DeepSea's list of the week's largest exchange transfers is all dollar tokens: $2.49 billion in 11 moves, led by Coinbase USDC and a single unlabeled Tron address moving USDT to and from Binance.

title: Whales and smart money put $3 million into ZAMA as it fell 14% in a week
dek: ZAMA drew the heaviest combined buying in DeepSea's weekly data, with coins moving to cold storage. Two USD.AI tokens, CHIP and sUSDai, came next.

title: DeFi lenders supplied $12.7 billion in a week. Morpho Blue had 84% of liquidations
dek: DeepSea's lending data for October 26 to November 1 shows deposits far ahead of withdrawals, borrowing almost exactly matched by repayments, and $12.69 million liquidated, most of it on Morpho Blue.

title: Whales cut $28.9 million of LBTC in a week. Smart money bought just $127,900
dek: Lombard's bitcoin token on Ethereum was the most sold token in DeepSea's weekly data, by a wide margin. Whales also cut $6.47 million of ARB, with DeepSea flagging moves to cold storage.

title: PEPE and SHIB flowed into US and European exchanges as $120 million in bitcoin left
dek: DeepSea's weekly data shows Western exchanges nearly flat overall, at minus $54.98 million. Under the surface, memecoins were deposited, bitcoin was withdrawn, Kraken lost 1,526 BTC and one $399.78 million USDC transfer left Coinbase.

title: 448 of 617 Solana influencers lost money last week. The best one won all seven days
dek: DeepSea's tracked crypto influencers on Solana closed the week $395,600 down. A trader called zeropnl made $82,900 with seven green days, while one smart money wallet lost $1.81 million in a single day.
